h: Atiku's camp criticises Shettima's remark about a Kano school and asks Tinubu to explain his own school record
p: Atiku's campaign has hit back at Vice President Kashim Shettima over a remark he made about a school in Kano. The camp reportedly said the vice president mocked the school and asked President Tinubu to explain his own educational record. No reply from the vice president's office was reported yet.
more: The exchange adds to growing tension between the APC and ADC camps.
Education records of leading candidates have been a recurring talking point online.
